# Hot Nails

> Nail studio · East Austin based in Austin, Texas. Thao and her husband do gel manicures that last for weeks, full sets and hand-painted art, and pedicures that never feel rushed. Walk-ins welcome on Airport Blvd.

## Services
- Gel, hard gel & dip: Clean, glossy gel that holds up. One client counted 32 days on hers.
- Full sets & nail art: Almond, coffin or stiletto, plain or loud: pink and white, prints, foil, glitter, gems and hand-painted line art.
- Pedicures & brows: The pedicure regulars call the best they've had: relaxing, thorough and never rushed. Add brows while you're here.

## About
Hot Nails is a small, family-run nail studio in East Austin, run by Thao and her husband. Clients don't get handed off to a rotating cast of techs: the two of them do the work themselves. In 2023 the studio moved from its old spot near Manor Road to 2001 Airport Blvd, and plenty of regulars followed. One brings her mom along. Reviewers say the same things again and again: they're the nicest people, they're welcoming and talkative, and they take their time. One client called it the best pedicure she's ever had because it never felt rushed. Another counted 32 days on her gel manicure. Plenty of clients come back every four weeks like clockwork for a hard gel manicure and a gel pedi. Walk-ins are welcome, and newcomers who find the studio online leave planning their next visit. As one reviewer put it: this is a family business, and they treat you like family.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Who does the nails at Hot Nails?
  A: Thao and her husband, the married couple who own the studio. They do the manicures, sets, pedicures and brows themselves.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Tuesday to Friday 9 am to 6:30 pm and Saturday 10 am to 6:30 pm. Closed Sunday. Mondays we open at 10 am; please call (512) 469-7468 first.
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Yes, walk-ins are welcome. It's a two-person studio, so calling ahead means you'll know when a chair is open.
- Q: How long does a gel manicure last?
  A: It depends on your nails and your routine, but our gel and hard gel are made to last for weeks. One client counted 32 days on hers.
- Q: Do you do nail art?
  A: Yes. Hand-painted prints and line art, French tips, foil, chrome, glitter, rhinestones, 3D flowers and seasonal designs. Bring a photo of what you want.
- Q: Where are you?
  A: 2001 Airport Blvd, Ste B, Austin, TX 78722, in East Austin near Cherrywood and Mueller. We moved here from near Manor Road in 2023.
